title: Antibiotic Duration in Post-appendectomy Abscess
brief_summary: This is a randomized study of patients 2-17 years old who are diagnosed with perforated appendicitis and develop an abscess after laparoscopy that is subsequently drained. Patients will be randomized to either receive an 8-day or a 4-day course of antibiotics. The aim of this study is to determine whether duration of antibiotic treatment at discharge demonstrates significant differences in clinical outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: 2 to 17 years of age
* Diagnosis of perforated appendicitis at laparoscopy
* Development of a post-appendectomy abscess that is treated with percutaneous drainage.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are allergic to ampicillin
